items.title: YCA Susan Wadsworth International Auditions Winner’s Announcement
items.description: Kiron Atom Tellian wins the 2024 YCA Susan Wadsworth International Auditions. He was additionally awarded eight special prizes.
items.details: They are: Paul A. Fish Memorial Prize Stern Young Artist Development Award The Buffalo Chamber Music Society Prize The Friends of Music Concerts Performance Award The Hayden’s Ferry Chamber Music Series Prize The Liliane Questel Recital Award The Serge Rachmaninoff Foundation Prize The Alexander Kasza-Kasser Concert PrizeI
